It sounds like you're feeling a bit discouraged about your clay bowl. It's completely normal to feel that way, especially when things don't turn out as expected. You might consider setting the bowl aside for now and coming back to it when you're feeling more positive about it. 

When you're ready to try again, you might want to focus on one specific aspect of the process, like keeping the rim even. This can help you build confidence and develop your skills without feeling overwhelmed. Remember, one attempt doesn't define your next one - they're separate experiences.
